title: Security & Privacy: Firewall
description: Turns on the application firewall, stealth mode and blocks incoming connections per app.

AllowSigned.title: Allow signed
AllowSigned.description:
If true, the system allows built-in software to receive incoming connections.

> Note:
> The system ensures that AllowSigned always has a value. If missing from the payload, the system sets it to true.

AllowSignedApp.title: Allow signed app
AllowSignedApp.description:
If true, the system allows downloaded signed software to receive incoming connections.

> Note:
> The system ensures that AllowSignedApp always has a value. If missing from the payload, the system sets it to true.

Applications.title: Applications
Applications.description: The list of apps with connections that the firewall controls.

Allowed.title: Allow connections
Allowed.description: If true, the system allows connections for the app.

BundleID.title: Application identifier
BundleID.description: The bundle identifier for the app.

BlockAllIncoming.title: Block all incoming
BlockAllIncoming.description: If true, the system enables blocking all incoming connections.

EnableFirewall.title: Enable firewall
EnableFirewall.description: If true, the system enables the firewall.

EnableStealthMode.title: Enable stealth mode
EnableStealthMode.description: If true, the system enables stealth mode.
